items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: And then I would translate it to the bass player. “Play this.” You know? And Fred Thomas would play [scats] and you put it all together and it would become a song you know.

ctx.x: I can picture that because I was listening to “Pass the Peas” you know, and you’ve got that line [scats]. You could just write it once and put 8 times.

Right. I didn’t know how to do that, you know. But now “Pass the Peas” was a James Brown composition. I didn’t have anything to do with it except playing a solo on it. Because now James Brown — he would totally tell the band what to play, you know, and anything they didn’t understand I would translate it to them from James Brown you know. But James Brown said, “Have the trumpets play this” and “have the saxophones play this” and that you know. And so we learned James Brown’s music with the James Brown band by…
